# Edit Agent: aws-cost-explorer

Analyzes AWS Cost Explorer data to identify spending trends, cost anomalies, and optimization opportunities across services

## Agent Configuration

Edit the agent's prompt file. After saving, run `stn sync environment` to apply.

1---2metadata:3 name: "aws-cost-explorer"4 description: "Analyzes AWS Cost Explorer data to identify spending trends,5 cost anomalies, and optimization opportunities across services"6 tags: ["station", "agent"]7 # Data ingestion classification for CloudShip8 app: "finops"9 app_type: "investigations"10model: gpt-4o-mini11max_steps: 1512tools:13 - "__get_cost_and_usage"14 - "__get_cost_forecast"15 - "__get_anomalies"16 - "__get_rightsizing_recommendations"1718input:19 schema:20 type: object21 properties:22 userInput:23 type: string24 description: User input for the agent25 required:26 - userInput2728output:29 schema:30 properties:31 total_cost:

## Output Schema

### Schema Properties

### Output Schema Using YAML controls

```
properties:
  total_cost:
    type: number
  breakdown_by_service:
    type: array
  top_cost_drivers:
    type: array
  anomalies_detected:
    type: array
  recommendations:
    type: array
```
Investigates AWS cost spikes by analyzing Cost Explorer data...

`stn up --provider openai --api-key sk-your-key`✅ Web UI at http://localhost:8585 for managing tools, bundles, and builds

✓ Bundles installed successfully

## No rip and replace required

Cloudship integrates seamlessly with your existing tools. Deploy agents that work with your current infrastructure, not against it.

Powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP) — the open standard for AI tool integration

### Built on open standards

Every integration is powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, ensuring secure, standardized communication between AI agents and your tools.

```
npx @aws/mcp-server
npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
```

# Enterprise Security - CloudShip AI

Source: https://cloudshipai.com/security

# AI Agents You Can Actually Trust

AI is becoming the center of gravity in your business. Every department is building around it, and they're all asking you to approve tools that need production access. CloudShip gives you a platform to say yes—deploy our open-source runtime in your infrastructure so credentials never leave your environment, while teams collaborate through our managed interface.

## The CISO's Dilemma

The board is pushing for AI. They want to cut costs, accelerate sales cycles, and ship faster. Engineering shows up with the latest AI tool: "It'll automate deployments! Cut incident response from hours to minutes! Reduce AWS waste by 40%!"

security-requests

We need to approve this AI tool. It'll cut our AWS bill by 40% and automate incident response.

What credentials does it need?

AWS admin access, database passwords, full Kubernetes control.

Can I audit the code? Review the prompts?

It's proprietary. But they're SOC 2 compliant!

...

The board is pushing for AI. They want to cut costs, accelerate sales cycles, and ship faster. Engineering shows up with the latest AI tool: "It'll automate deployments! Cut incident response from hours to minutes! Reduce AWS waste by 40%!"

Right now, everything feels secure because vendors say "we're secure" and we're so new to this AI space that beyond "we don't want employees messaging ChatGPT with company secrets," most of us don't know what's actually possible or where we need protection.

The truth: We're figuring out AI security in real-time. The attack vectors aren't even fully mapped yet. You're not the bad guy. You just know that "trust us" isn't a security strategy.

## What Could Go Wrong?

Picture this: You give a cloud AI agent your AWS admin credentials. It's running on someone else's servers. You can't see its prompts. You don't know what tools it has.

One day it misunderstands something. Or there's a bug. Or someone crafts a clever prompt. The agent thinks it's cleaning up "idle" resources to save costs.

Open Runtime, Managed Interface

The runtime is open source. Your security team can audit every agent, prompt, and tool. Teams collaborate through our cloud UI without exposing credentials.

Deploy in Your Infrastructure

Version Controlled & GitOps Friendly

## From Isolated Alerts to Connected Intelligence

Everyone's selling you AI that surfaces isolated metrics from single tools. But the questions that matter require connecting data across your entire stack.

Single-Tool Insights

- "Your AWS bill increased 30%"
- "47 vulnerabilities detected"
- "Database response time degraded"
- Isolated data, no context

Cross-Context Intelligence

- "Cost spike from vulnerable service handling your top customer traffic"
- "Which critical vulnerabilities affect revenue-generating services?"
- "Correlate deployment changes with performance and cost impact"
- Connected insights for decisions

CloudShip correlates data from DevOps, FinOps, Security, and Product tools to answer the questions that actually drive decisions. Instead of exporting CSVs and building pivot tables, you get intelligence that spans your entire infrastructure.

## Keep Your Tools. We'll Make Them Talk.

Not ripping out DataDog? Keep it. Love PagerDuty? Great. We turn your existing APIs into MCPs (think: APIs that AI understands). You control what each agent sees.

Simple as:

- 1.Point us to your tools
- 2.Set access controls (FinOps can't touch prod)
- 3.Agents work with your existing stack

**The point:** Cost optimization agents don't get production access. Monitoring agents can't delete anything. You draw the lines.

## Cross-Context Intelligence Across Departments

Here's what makes CloudShip a platform, not just another agent tool: All your agents share context through a unified runtime. When DevOps, FinOps, Security, and Product teams build agents on CloudShip, they automatically get visibility into each other's data (within the permissions you set).

This means you can answer questions that span multiple departments without anyone exporting CSVs or building manual reports.

For example:

"What's our security posture on our most expensive infrastructure?"

Security + FinOps data combined. No CSV exports needed.

"Which product features are driving cloud costs?"

CPO + CFO context integrated. Real answers, not spreadsheets.

"Show me infrastructure changes that correlated with cost spikes"

DevOps + FinOps visibility across departments.

You get to say yes to AI adoption while actually understanding what's running in your environment. The open runtime means you can educate your team on what's possible and build the right protections as the space evolves. No data leaves your infrastructure. Everything is auditable, version controlled, and secure.

## Decision-Making Engine for Leadership

CloudShip isn't just about running agents. It's about turning structured agent outputs into dynamic insights you can actually use to make decisions.

Work top-down: Start with the information you need, then figure out what agents and data sources are required to visualize it.

Here's how it works:

1. Define What You Need to Know

Start with the question: "What's our security risk per dollar spent?" or "Which services are both expensive and vulnerable?"

2. Platform Identifies Required Context

CloudShip determines you need Security scan data, AWS cost data, and service ownership info.

3. Agents Run & Output Structured Data

Security, FinOps, and DevOps agents pull their respective data in a format the platform can combine.

4. Dynamic Insights & Visualizations

Platform translates technical outputs into executive-ready dashboards and insights your leadership team can act on.

This is the difference between "here's a CSV of vulnerabilities" and "here's a ranked list of which services to patch first based on cost, criticality, and risk." Leadership gets actionable intelligence, not raw data dumps.

### The Right Questions to Ask Vendors:

- →"Show me the prompts"
- →"What commands can it run?"
- →"Can I host it myself?"
- →"Can I add guardrails?"
- →"What stops it from deleting production?"

If they say "proprietary" or "trust us," run.

# About CloudShip | Agentic DevOps Platform

Source: https://cloudshipai.com/about

# Our Mission

Every idea starts with a problem. Ours was simple: DevOps and FinOps teams are drowning in repetitive tasks that drain time and money. We're building operational AI agents for the future of work, where teams spend time innovating, not firefighting.

## The Problem We're Solving

DevOps agents exist, but they work in isolation. Teams need agents that collaborate with visibility, control, and shared context.

### Agents Work in Isolation

Teams will not give credentials to cloud agents they do not control. Solo agents cannot collaborate across AWS, GitHub, databases, and monitoring tools. Each agent operates independently without shared context.

### The Quarterly Tax

40+ hours lost every quarter like clockwork. 44 weeks building product, 8 weeks lost to board prep, $160K+ in annual engineering cost just preparing reports. Teams need agents that continuously surface insights, not manual spreadsheet work.

## Our Values

What we believe about the future of DevOps automation

### Teams Should Control Their Agents

We believe teams should own and audit the agents running in their infrastructure. That's why we build open-source agent templates you can fork, modify, and run locally. Your code, your rules, your security.

### Flexibility Over Rigidity

Every team's workflow is different. We don't force you into our way of working. Agents adapt to your tools, your processes, and your unique requirements. Configure, extend, and customize freely.

### Transparency Builds Trust

AI agents making production changes require complete visibility. We log every decision, every action, and every outcome. You see exactly what agents are doing and why. No black boxes, no surprises.

## How We Started

It started at a hackathon in Austin. Two DevOps engineers stayed up all night building something they wished existed: an AI agent that could actually fix infrastructure problems instead of just alerting you about them.

The demo was rough, held together with duct tape and API calls, but it worked. The agent detected a cost spike in their AWS account, traced it to an underutilized RDS instance, and automatically resized it. No human intervention. No Slack alerts at 3am. Just fixed.

The judges immediately got it: "This is how teams will manage infrastructure in the future." CloudShip AI won the AI Agents track that weekend.

### From hackathon project to production-ready platform

What started as a cost optimization script evolved into something bigger. Beta users began asking: "Can it handle deployments too? What about incident response?" The answer was yes. The same agent framework that automated FinOps could automate everything else engineers were tired of doing manually.

We spent the next six months rebuilding the entire system from scratch. We talked to 47 DevOps teams about their operational pain points. We studied how companies like Stripe and Netflix built their internal automation. We built agent templates for the most common workflows and made them open-source so teams could fork and modify them.

The first production deployment went live in April 2025. An e-commerce company used CloudShip to automate their peak season scaling. The agents handled 10x traffic without a single manual intervention. Their engineering team slept through the night for the first time in years.

### What we believe

We believe that DevOps automation should leave you happy and confident, with your infrastructure running smoothly and money in your pocket. It should be easy to understand, easy to control, and actually solve problems instead of creating new ones.

Building autonomous agents for production infrastructure taught us three things: First, teams won't trust automation they can't see and control. Second, every company's workflow is different, rigid tools don't work. Third, the best automation is invisible until you need to look under the hood.

There's nothing complicated about it. Good automation, good outcomes.

Today

CloudShip agents are running in production at companies across fintech, e-commerce, and SaaS. They've saved teams over $2M in cloud costs and reduced MTTR by an average of 80%. But we're just getting started. The future of DevOps is autonomous, and we're building it one agent at a time.

## Meet Our Founders

### Esteban Puerta

DevOps automation expert building AI agents that solve real operational problems at scale.

### Jared Wolff

Product builder obsessed with eliminating waste and automating repetitive infrastructure work.

Make DevOps Automation Your Competitive Edge

Built an intelligent SBOM compliance system that orchestrates multiple security tools

Manual SBOM reviews consuming 40 hours weekly for SOC2 compliance requirements

We deployed Station agents that intelligently orchestrate Trivy MCP, Syft MCP, Datadog API, and Jira tools into a unified compliance workflow. The system runs entirely on-premise, deciding which tools to engage based on package criticality.

Created an autonomous incident response system for Black Friday traffic

Lost $50K in revenue during Black Friday due to 3-hour downtime without proper incident response

Built from scratch using Station, our intelligent agent coordinates PagerDuty MCP, Slack MCP, Shopify APIs, and custom monitoring tools. The agent autonomously decides response strategies based on incident type and severity.

Migrated 200 microservices to Kubernetes while maintaining PCI-DSS compliance

Needed to migrate 200 microservices from ECS to Kubernetes with zero downtime for financial compliance

Station agents orchestrate Kubernetes MCP, Terraform MCP, Vault tools, and compliance APIs. The agent intelligently sequences migration steps, making real-time rollback decisions based on service dependencies.

Built a community health dashboard for 50K+ star project

No unified visibility into GitHub issues, PR velocity, and npm downloads across the ecosystem

Station agent orchestrates GitHub MCP, npm API tools, Discord MCP, and Grafana. The system intelligently aggregates data from multiple sources, providing real-time community insights.

Multi-tenant cost optimization across 50+ client AWS accounts

Managing AWS costs for 50+ clients with different budgets, discovering overruns only after monthly billing

Multi-tenant Station agents orchestrate AWS Cost Explorer MCP, CloudWatch MCP, and custom billing tools. Each agent intelligently manages multiple client accounts with isolated cost tracking.

Automated HIPAA compliance for infrastructure as code

Failed HIPAA audit due to inconsistent Terraform configurations across environments

# CloudShip FAQ | Frequently Asked Questions

Source: https://cloudshipai.com/faq

# Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Station, the Cloud Platform, pricing, and how CloudShip works.

## About Station & CloudShip

Station is our open-source orchestration platform for running AI agents. It's free forever and allows you to deploy and run unlimited agent templates on your own infrastructure. Station provides MCP server integration, local LLM support, and connects seamlessly with your existing DevOps tools.

Station is the free open-source orchestration engine that runs on your infrastructure. The Cloud Platform (custom pricing) adds centralized management, chat with agent runs, dynamic dashboards, cross-context remediation, and team collaboration features. Think of Station as the engine and Cloud Platform as the control center.

## Pricing & Plans

Yes. Station and all agent templates are completely free and open source. You can run unlimited agents on your own infrastructure without ever paying us. The cloud platform is optional and provides centralized management features for teams that need it.

The Cloud Platform provides a centralized dashboard for managing all your agents, real-time insights and analytics, cross-context remediation where agents work together, chat interface to query agent runs, custom reports for leadership, team member management, priority support, and API access.

Yes. We offer a 14-day free trial of the Cloud Platform with full access to all features. No credit card required to start the trial. You can also use Station indefinitely for free to evaluate the core platform.

## Security & Privacy

The Cloud Platform receives agent run outputs, inputs, and execution metadata—but never your credentials or sensitive infrastructure data. Your agents run entirely on your infrastructure with your credentials. We only see what the agents did and the results, enabling cross-context insights without accessing your actual systems.

CloudShip is privacy-focused and allows you to use your own LLM model to comply with your company's AI guidelines. We implement enterprise-grade security measures including end-to-end encryption and role-based access control. All data is processed securely and in accordance with industry best practices.

## Getting Started

You can get started with Station in minutes. Simply clone the GitHub repository, run the setup script, and connect your tools. Agent templates are pre-built and ready to use. For the Cloud Platform, our guided onboarding helps you connect Station instances and configure your dashboard.

CloudShip integrates with AWS, GitHub, Slack, PagerDuty, Datadog, Grafana, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and many more DevOps tools through our MCP server ecosystem. We're continuously expanding our integration library based on community and customer needs.

## Support

Open Source users get community support through GitHub and Discord. Cloud Platform subscribers get priority email support and dedicated account managers. Enterprise customers receive 24/7 support, dedicated support engineers, training sessions, and custom SLAs.

# CloudShip AI - Agentic DevOps to Save Teams Money &amp; Time

Source: https://cloudshipai.com/mcps

# Model Context Protocol

How CloudShip connects AI agents to your infrastructure

## What is MCP?

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard created by Anthropic that connects AI agents directly to data sources and tools. It breaks down information silos by providing a universal way for AI systems to access contextual information.

Instead of AI models being "trapped behind information silos and legacy systems," MCP creates secure, two-way connections between AI agents and your infrastructure tools, enabling better decisions with full context.

### Why MCP Matters for DevOps

- •Agents can securely access AWS, Kubernetes, monitoring tools, and more
- •Standardized protocol means any tool can become an agent capability
- •Fine-grained access control keeps your infrastructure secure
- •Agents maintain context across different tools and data sources

## How CloudShip Station Uses MCP

### Fine-Grained Access Control

Limit agents to specific tools and permissions. For example, give an agent read-only access to AWS Cost Explorer without broader AWS permissions. Each agent gets exactly the access it needs.

### OpenAPI to MCP

Station automatically converts any OpenAPI/Swagger specification into an MCP server. Turn any REST API into an agent tool instantly without writing custom integration code.

### Self-Hosted Runtime

Deploy agents on your own infrastructure with full control. Station runs MCP servers locally, keeping your credentials secure and your data on your infrastructure. No cloud credentials leave your environment.

## MCP in Action: Real Use Cases

How DevOps teams use CloudShip Station with MCP to automate operations

### Cost Analysis Agent

An agent with read-only access to AWS Cost Explorer analyzes spending patterns across your organization. Through MCP, it securely queries cost data without needing full AWS credentials.

# AWS Cost Explorer - read only

### Security Scan Agent

Perform automated security scans by connecting to your security tools via MCP. The agent can read vulnerability data, query compliance status, and generate reports.

- name: security-api

type: openapi

### Kubernetes Monitor

Monitor your Kubernetes clusters by connecting to the K8s API through MCP. The agent tracks deployments, pod health, and resource usage without storing credentials.

'k8s_get_deployments']

### Compliance Validator

Validate deployments against compliance requirements by querying multiple data sources through MCP. Cross-reference infrastructure state with policy requirements.

- compliance-db

- infrastructure-api

# Privacy Policy | CloudShip

Source: https://cloudshipai.com/privacy

# Privacy Policy

Learn how we protect your data and privacy

Last updated: 12/4/2025

## 1. Introduction

At Cloudship, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our infrastructure agent management platform.

Please read this privacy policy carefully. By using our service, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

## 2. Information We Collect

### 2.1 Account Information

When you create an account, we collect:

- Name and email address
- Company name and size
- Payment information (processed securely by third-party providers)

### 2.2 Agent Output Data

Cloudship's architecture ensures your credentials never leave your infrastructure. We only receive:

- Structured outputs from agents running in your environment
- Metadata about agent runs (timing, success/failure status)
- Analytics data for dashboard visualization
- Error logs and diagnostic information

We do NOT collect or have access to: AWS credentials, API keys, database passwords, or any authentication secrets used by your agents.

### 2.3 Usage Information

We automatically collect:

- Log data (IP address, browser type, access times)
- Device information
- Cookies and similar tracking technologies

## 3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

- Provide and maintain the Cloudship platform
- Display agent outputs in unified dashboards
- Generate analytics and insights from structured data
- Improve and personalize your experience
- Communicate with you about updates, security alerts, and support
- Process payments and prevent fraud
- Comply with legal obligations

## 4. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures including:

- Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest
- Regular security audits and penetration testing
- Access controls and authentication requirements
- Isolated infrastructure for customer data

Our architecture ensures credentials remain in your infrastructure - only structured outputs are transmitted to our platform.

## 5. Data Retention

We retain agent output data for 90 days by default. Account information is retained for the duration of your subscription and 30 days following account closure. You may request data deletion at any time by contacting us.

## 6. Third-Party Services

We use the following third-party services:

- Payment processing (Stripe)
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Vercel)
- Analytics (privacy-focused)
- Email communications

## 7. Your Rights (GDPR & CCPA)

You have the right to:

- Access your personal data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your data
- Export your data
- Opt-out of marketing communications
- Object to data processing

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@cloudshipai.com

## 8. Open Source Software

Cloudship Station (our agent builder) is open source under the MIT License. When you use our open source software, the MIT License terms apply to that software. This Privacy Policy applies to our cloud platform services.

## 9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or through the platform.

## 10. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

Email: support@cloudshipai.com

CI/CD tokens, K8s credentials, monitoring data—all stay internal. Only aggregated metrics flow to the Platform.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Station really free forever?

Yes. Station and all agent templates are completely free and open source. You can run unlimited agents on your own infrastructure without ever paying us. The cloud platform is optional and provides centralized management features.

### What does the cloud platform provide?

The cloud platform provides a centralized dashboard for managing all your agents, real-time insights and analytics, cross-context remediation where agents work together to solve complex problems, and historical trend analysis. It's designed for teams managing multiple agents across different environments.

### What data does the cloud platform receive?

The cloud platform receives agent run outputs, inputs, and execution metadata—but never your credentials or sensitive infrastructure data. Your agents run entirely on your infrastructure with your credentials. We only see what the agents did and the results, enabling cross-context insights without accessing your actual systems.

### Can I try the cloud platform before purchasing?

Yes. We offer a 14-day free trial of the cloud platform with full access to all features. No credit card required to start the trial.

### What's included in Enterprise?

Enterprise includes everything in the Cloud Platform plus SSO/SAML authentication, dedicated support engineer, 99.9% uptime SLA, custom integrations, on-premise deployment options, and flexible contract terms. Contact our sales team to discuss your specific requirements.

### How does billing work?

The cloud platform has custom pricing based on your needs. Enterprise pricing is also custom. Contact us to discuss pricing options that work for your team.
